sources.title: Burma Independence (Retention of British Nationality) Regulations1948
sources.note: Original1948 legal text indexed and read, explanatory note printed279:4January1948 independence and eligible declarations retaining British subject status. This is a historical legal document, not current nationality advice.

sources.title: United Nations Statistics Division: Myanmar country profile
sources.note: Original UN factual country profile read, UN membership date19April1948. No current population or other variable figures imported.

sources.title: Frank N. Trager, The Failure of U Nu and the Return of the Armed Forces in Burma (1963)
sources.note: Original scholarly extract read: constitutional caretaker1958-1960, U Nu election1960,2March1962 coup and Revolutionary Council. Avoid conflating caretaker transfer with the1962 seizure.

sources.title: Tin Maung Maung Than: The End of the Socialist Era, State Dominance in Myanmar
sources.note: Original academic chapter summary read:1974 constitution formal one-party order; earlier socialist roots; twenty-year plan and developmental failure,1988 end. No exact production statistics inferred.

sources.title: International Institute of Social History: Guide to International Archives, Supplement over 2000
sources.note: Original scholarly archival guide indexed PDF, printed332, Burma political and social movements.1974-1988 context,1990 NLD result not honored, collected leaflets/reports/statements/periodicals. Text reopened via exact indexed URL.

sources.title: ILO Commission of Inquiry, Towards Freedom and Dignity in Myanmar (2023)
sources.note: Original205-pagePDF directly read, paras206-209,213,221:2008 reserved military powers,2011 legislature,2021 coup, protest and strikes, ethnic armed organizations and PDFs. Entire work counted together. Uses Trager for1958 distinctions.

sources.title: UN Secretary-General, Situation of human rights in Myanmar, A/71/308 (2016)
sources.note: Original indexed UN report summary:2015 NLD victory,2016 Htin Kyaw and State Counsellor, minority disenfranchisement. Contemporary optimism not treated as permanent outcome.

sources.title: UNHCR: Rohingya emergency
sources.note: Original current institutional account read, August2017 mass flight after military crackdown, statelessness and discrimination. Avoid variable exact cumulative refugee count and avoid claiming an ICJ final judgment.

sources.title: IIMM annual report announcement,11August2026
sources.note: Original investigative announcement directly read, lines35-40. Report covers1July2025-30June2026, elections completedJanuary2026 and continued military attacks. Findings explicitly attributed, not a criminal conviction or a live control map.

sources.title: World Bank: Poverty Report, Myanmar Living Conditions Survey2017
sources.note: Original2019 statistical report summary read. Same national poverty method48.2percent2005 to24.8percent2017; geographic differences. Not a2026 poverty estimate.

sources.title: WHO: Myanmar eliminates trachoma,11September2020
sources.note: Original WHO release directly read, lines102-106:1964 program, surgery/antibiotics/WASH/education/rural access and2020 validation as eliminated public-health problem. Not worldwide eradication or zero future infection.

sources.title: UNICEF, A Simple Turn of a Tap,1July2026
sources.note: Original report directly read. Bandar village,Amarapura,March2025 earthquake,seven-year-old and family,solar-powered supply,fly-proof household latrine,20-liter container and hygiene learning. Two public passages combined below200 words; no causal clinical effect claimed.

sources.title: UNICEF Myanmar Humanitarian Situation Report No.4,January-December2025
sources.note: Original10-pagePDF directly read. Education printed6/PDFpage6:854401 children assisted,1328 temporary spaces established or maintained, basic literacy/numeracy/social-emotional learning. Achieved figures not appeal targets, no universal school restoration.

sources.title: UNESCO Committee decision16.COM8.b.27,Thanakha nomination (2021)
sources.note: Original decision indexed text read; direct page challenge. Query site.ich.unesco.org "Thanakha" "leaf" "2021" returned full decision. Bark/water/stone, patterns and elder-child learning. Nomination was REFERRED, not inscribed; no medicinal efficacy claim.

sources.title: UNESCO: Myanmar traditional New Year Ata Thingyan festival
sources.note: Original2024 listing read, five days, typical mid-April,water,foodgiving,care for elders and family return. Regional variation preserved; no claim nationwide safe festivities during current conflict.

sources.title: British Council Myanmar:2026 summer intensive English courses, Burmese page
sources.note: Original dated course page directly read, line11 exact မင်္ဂလာပါ; classesMarch24-April9,2026,Yangon. Unicode witness is contemporary print, not inscription.

sources.title: United World Schools: Learn Our Languages
sources.note: Original educational charity7-pagePDF directly read, PDFpage2 Burmese row: Maingalarpar and Hello. Burmese glyph text matches BritishCouncil witness after PDF spacing. No claim this is a scientific transliteration or all Myanmar languages.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Distinct modern country card; no aliases attached.
batchIdentityNotes.evidence: The exact indexed ID runs1945-present. Its early bounds approximately92.123-101.015E/10.120-28.412N become92.303-101.180E/9.933-28.336N in modern geometry. Manifest intervals1945-1960,1960-1994,1994-2000,2000-2010,2010-2020,2020-2100. Final2100 is a sentinel, not a forecast. These are national outlines, not ethnic, sovereignty-in-practice or conflict-control polygons.
batchIdentityNotes.historicalScope: 1945 precedes4January1948 independence. Parliamentary1948-1958 and1960-1962; constitutional caretaker1958-1960 distinct; RevolutionaryCouncil1962-1974; socialist1974-1988; military1988-2011; limitedreform2011-2016; NLDcivilian2016-2021 underreservedmilitarypowers; coupandconflict2021 onward. Earlier burma1783-1878 and burmese-kingdoms1492-1650 stay separate.
batchIdentityNotes.freshness: Sources checked22September2026. Latest dated conflict witness11August2026 covering through30June2026. No claim live current officeholders or territorial control.
